healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the personal access token by calling GET /v1/me. Takes no input and returns the authenticated user's id, handle, avatar URL, and email. This is a Tier 3 (cheapest) call — safe to use for connection testing. Note: the spec omits 401 from this endpoint's documented responses but the live API returns it on a missing or invalid token; both 401 and 403 are treated as authentication failures.

file.get.title: Get File
file.get.description: Fetch a file's full document tree by file key. WARNING: this is a Tier 1 endpoint, capped at 20 calls per MONTH (not per minute) on View/Collab seats — the single biggest operational trap in this connector. Prefer file.getNodes with explicit ids and depth instead, which is far cheaper for targeted reads; reserve file.get for cases that genuinely need the entire document. Always pass ids and/or depth when you can to limit the response size. The response has no file id field — the file key you passed in is the identifier. Use file.getMeta for a shareable URL.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key, from the file's URL.

version.description: A specific version id to fetch instead of the latest.

ids.description: Comma-separated node ids to limit the returned document tree. Strongly recommended given the monthly call cap.

depth.description: How many levels deep into the document tree to traverse. Strongly recommended given the monthly call cap.

geometry.description: Set to "paths" to export vector data.

pluginData.description: Comma-separated plugin ids (or "shared") whose plugin data to include.

branchData.description: Include branch metadata in the response.

file.getNodes.title: Get File Nodes
file.getNodes.description: Fetch specific nodes from a file by id, without downloading the entire document tree. ids is required — Figma rejects this call without it, and it is also the whole reason to prefer this operation over file.get, which is capped at 20 calls per month on View/Collab seats. Pass depth to further limit how far each node's subtree is traversed.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key, from the file's URL.

ids.description: Comma-separated node ids to fetch. Required.

version.description: A specific version id to fetch instead of the latest.

depth.description: How many levels deep into each node's subtree to traverse.

geometry.description: Set to "paths" to export vector data.

pluginData.description: Comma-separated plugin ids (or "shared") whose plugin data to include.

file.getMeta.title: Get File Metadata
file.getMeta.description: Fetch a file's metadata — name, folder, editor type, role, thumbnail, and shareable URL — without any document content. This is the cheap way to resolve a file key to a shareable link (file.get and file.getNodes do not return one).

fileKey.description: File key or branch key, from the file's URL.

file.listVersions.title: List File Versions
file.listVersions.description: List the named/saved version history of a file, newest first. This is the only Figma list operation that paginates: pass pageSize to control the page size and before/after (version ids) to page. nextPage is a full URL Figma returns in pagination.next_page; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key, from the file's URL.

pageSize.description: Results per page. Figma defaults to 30.

before.description: Return versions before this version id (older page).

after.description: Return versions after this version id (newer page).

image.render.title: Render Images
image.render.description: Render one or more nodes to PNG, JPG, SVG, or PDF and get back image URLs. ids is required — this call is useless without it. The returned URLs point at short-lived CDN links on hosts Figma does not document and does not keep stable; fetch the bytes promptly and do not rely on the link persisting. A null value for a node id in the response means that node failed to render. This connector does not download the image bytes itself and does not allowlist the CDN host — only api.figma.com is reachable through this connector.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key, from the file's URL.

ids.description: Comma-separated node ids to render. Required.

version.description: A specific version id to render instead of the latest.

scale.description: A number between 0.01 and 4, the image scaling factor.

svgOutlineText.description: Whether text elements are rendered as outlines in SVG output.

svgIncludeId.description: Include id attributes in SVG output.

svgIncludeNodeId.description: Include the Figma node id as an attribute in SVG output.

contentsOnly.description: Exclude overlapping content that falls outside a node's bounds.

useAbsoluteBounds.description: Use each node's absolute rendered bounds rather than its own bounding box.

image.listFills.title: List Image Fills
image.listFills.description: List the download URLs for every image fill (raster image used as a fill) referenced anywhere in a file, keyed by imageRef. Returns everything in one call — there is no pagination. Note this endpoint's success envelope is {error: false, status: 200, meta: {images: {...}}}, different from image.render's {err: null, images: {...}}.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key, from the file's URL.

comment.list.title: List Comments
comment.list.description: List every comment on a file, including replies. Returns the entire set in one call — this endpoint does not paginate.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key, from the file's URL.

asMd.description: Return comment message text as markdown instead of plain text.

comment.create.title: Create Comment
comment.create.description: Post a new comment on a file, or reply to an existing one. message is required. To reply, pass commentId of the comment being replied to — it must be a root comment; Figma cannot reply to a reply.

fileKey.description: File key to comment on.

commentId.description: Root comment id to reply to. Omit to start a new comment thread. Must be a root comment — Figma cannot reply to a reply.

clientMeta.description: Where the comment is pinned: a Vector {x,y}, a FrameOffset {node_id,node_offset}, a Region, or a FrameOffsetRegion.

comment.delete.title: Delete Comment
comment.delete.description: Permanently delete a comment from a file. Figma answers with an empty body on success, so the result echoes back the file key and comment id that were deleted.

fileKey.description: File key the comment belongs to.

folder.listForTeam.title: List Team Folders
folder.listForTeam.description: List the folders in a team. Folders replace the deprecated Projects concept — this connector does not implement the deprecated /v1/teams/{id}/projects endpoint. Returns the entire set in one call — this endpoint does not paginate.

folder.listFiles.title: List Folder Files
folder.listFiles.description: List the files in a folder. Folders replace the deprecated Projects concept — this connector does not implement the deprecated /v1/projects/{id}/files endpoint. Returns the entire set in one call — this endpoint does not paginate. Each returned file's key is the file_key every other file/image/comment operation takes.

branchData.description: Include branch metadata for each file.

comment.listReactions.title: List Comment Reactions
comment.listReactions.description: List emoji reactions on a Figma comment. Returns the entire set in one call — this endpoint does not paginate.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key.

commentId.description: Comment id whose reactions to list.

comment.createReaction.title: Add Comment Reaction
comment.createReaction.description: Post an emoji reaction on a Figma comment. emoji is the shortcode or glyph Figma stores on the comment.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key.

emoji.description: Emoji shortcode or glyph, such as :heart:.

comment.deleteReaction.title: Delete Comment Reaction
comment.deleteReaction.description: Remove a specific emoji reaction the authenticated user added to a Figma comment. Figma answers with an empty body on success, so the result echoes the file key, comment id, and emoji that were deleted.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key.

emoji.description: Emoji shortcode or glyph to remove.

file.listComponents.title: List File Components
file.listComponents.description: List published components in a Figma file used as a library. The file key must be a main file, not a branch. Returns the entire set in one call — this endpoint does not paginate.

fileKey.description: File key of the library file, not a branch key.

file.listComponentSets.title: List File Component Sets
file.listComponentSets.description: List published component sets in a Figma file used as a library. The file key must be a main file, not a branch. Returns the entire set in one call — this endpoint does not paginate.

fileKey.description: File key of the library file, not a branch key.

file.listStyles.title: List File Styles
file.listStyles.description: List published styles (fill, text, effect, grid) in a Figma file used as a library. The file key must be a main file, not a branch. Returns the entire set in one call — this endpoint does not paginate.

fileKey.description: File key of the library file, not a branch key.

component.get.title: Get Component
component.get.description: Fetch metadata for a published Figma component by its unique component key (not a node id).

componentSet.get.title: Get Component Set
componentSet.get.description: Fetch metadata for a published Figma component set by its unique key.

style.get.title: Get Style
style.get.description: Fetch metadata for a published Figma style by its unique style key.

team.listComponents.title: List Team Components
team.listComponents.description: List published components in a Figma team's library. Paginate with pageSize and after/before cursor integers from a previous response.

team.listStyles.title: List Team Styles
team.listStyles.description: List published styles in a Figma team's library. Paginate with pageSize and after/before cursor integers from a previous response.

variables.listLocal.title: List Local Variables
variables.listLocal.description: List local and remote variables in a Figma file or branch, including mode-specific values that the published-variables endpoint omits. Enterprise-plan access is required for the Variables API.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key.

devResources.list.title: List Dev Resources
devResources.list.description: List development resources attached to nodes in a Figma file. Pass nodeIds as a comma-separated list to limit the response; omit it to return every resource in the file.

fileKey.description: File key.

nodeIds.description: Comma-separated node ids to filter by.

devResources.create.title: Create Dev Resource
devResources.create.description: Attach a uniquely-URLed development resource to a Figma node, such as a storybook or issue tracker link. Figma allows up to 10 resources per node.

fileKey.description: File key the node belongs to.

nodeId.description: Node id to attach the resource to.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the development resource.

webhooks.create.title: Create Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create a Figma webhook that POSTs one event type to an HTTPS endpoint. context and contextId are both required: team with a team id, project with a project id, or file with a file key. Figma sends an immediate PING to the endpoint unless status is PAUSED. The passcode is echoed in every payload so the receiver can verify the call came from Figma. Requires the webhooks:write scope.

eventType.description: WebhookV2 event type, such as FILE_COMMENT, FILE_UPDATE, FILE_DELETE, FILE_VERSION_UPDATE, or LIBRARY_PUBLISH. See the Webhooks Events reference for the full list.

context.description: Context the webhook is attached to.

contextId.description: Id of the team, project, or file to monitor.

endpoint.description: Publicly reachable HTTPS URL that receives the POST.

passcode.description: Secret echoed back in each payload so the endpoint can verify Figma as the caller.

status.description: Initial state. ACTIVE (the default) also sends an immediate PING; PAUSED creates the webhook silently.

description.description: Optional human-readable label for the webhook.

webhooks.list.title: List Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List the webhooks attached to one context — team, project, or file — through GET /v2/webhooks with context and context_id. This is the supported replacement for the deprecated GET /v2/teams/{team_id}/webhooks path. The per-context response returns the entire set; pagination only applies to the plan_api_id variant, which this connector does not expose. Requires the webhooks:read scope.

context.description: Context type to query: team, project, or file.

contextId.description: Id of the team, project, or file whose webhooks to list.

nextPage.description: Cursor for the next page when the plan_api_id variant paginates.

prevPage.description: Cursor for the previous page when the plan_api_id variant paginates.

webhooks.get.title: Get Webhook
webhooks.get.description: Fetch one webhook by id. The passcode is returned as an empty string on reads. Requires the webhooks:read scope; a 404 means the webhook does not exist or the token cannot see it.

webhookId.description: Webhook id returned by webhooks.create or webhooks.list.

webhooks.update.title: Update Webhook
webhooks.update.description: Update an existing webhook's event type, endpoint, passcode, status, or description. Provide only the fields to change — omitted fields are left untouched. Requires the webhooks:write scope.

webhookId.description: Webhook id returned by webhooks.create or webhooks.list.

eventType.description: New event type that triggers the webhook.

endpoint.description: New HTTPS endpoint that receives the POST.

passcode.description: New passcode echoed back in each payload.

status.description: New state: ACTIVE to resume delivery, PAUSED to stop it.

description.description: New description. An empty string deletes the description.

inputSchema.description: Fields to change on the webhook.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Permanently delete a webhook by id. This cannot be reversed. Figma returns the deleted WebhookV2 object. Requires the webhooks:write scope.

webhookId.description: Webhook id returned by webhooks.create or webhooks.list.

webhooks.listRequests.title: List Webhook Requests
webhooks.listRequests.description: List the requests Figma sent to one webhook over the last seven days, for debugging deliveries. Each entry carries the request payload, the endpoint's response, and any error message. Requires the webhooks:read scope.

webhookId.description: Webhook id returned by webhooks.create or webhooks.list.

inputSchema.description: Webhook whose recent requests to list.

variables.listPublished.title: List Published Variables
variables.listPublished.description: List the variables and variable collections published from a main file (not a branch), including each item's subscribed_id and updatedAt. Modes are omitted here — use variables.listLocal to read mode values. Enterprise-plan members only; requires the file_variables:read scope.

fileKey.description: Main file key, not a branch key, since branches cannot publish.

inputSchema.description: File to read published variables from.

variables.description: Published variables keyed by variable id.

variableCollections.description: Published collections keyed by collection id.

variables.modify.title: Create, Modify, or Delete Variables
variables.modify.description: Bulk create, update, and delete variable collections, modes, variables, and mode values in one atomic request (4MB body limit). Provide at least one of the four arrays; each item's action selects CREATE, UPDATE, or DELETE. Temporary ids let items in the same request reference each other, and the response maps them to real ids in tempIdToRealId. Enterprise-plan members with edit access only; requires the file_variables:write scope.

fileKey.description: File key or branch key whose variables to modify.

variableCollections.description: Variable collection changes (action CREATE, UPDATE, or DELETE).

variableModes.description: Mode changes within collections (action CREATE, UPDATE, or DELETE).

variables.description: Variable changes (action CREATE, UPDATE, or DELETE).

variableModeValues.description: Value assignments for a variable in a specific mode.

tempIdToRealId.description: Temporary id to real id map.

activityLogs.list.title: List Activity Logs
activityLogs.list.description: List organization activity-log events with an optional event-type filter and Unix timestamp window. Responses paginate: when nextPage is true, pass cursor back to continue from the last event seen. Enterprise-plan organization admins only; the token must carry the org:activity_log_read scope.

events.description: Comma-separated event types to include, such as org_user_create,org_user_delete. All events are returned when omitted.

startTime.description: Unix timestamp of the least recent event to include. Defaults to one year ago.

endTime.description: Unix timestamp of the most recent event to include. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 1000.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response's nextPage to continue past the last event seen.

analytics.componentActions.title: Get Library Analytics Component Action Data
analytics.componentActions.description: Weekly time-series counts of component insertions and detachments for a published library file, grouped by component or team. Data covers up to one year. Enterprise-plan organizations only; requires the library_analytics:read scope.

fileKey.description: File key of the published library to read analytics for.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); data starts from the week containing it. Defaults to one year ago.

endDate.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); data ends at the week containing it. Defaults to the latest full week.

rows.description: Analytics rows; columns depend on groupBy.

analytics.componentUsages.title: Get Library Analytics Component Usage Data
analytics.componentUsages.description: Summary of how many instances of each component in a published library exist across files, grouped by component or by file. Enterprise-plan organizations only; requires the library_analytics:read scope.

fileKey.description: File key of the published library to read analytics for.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

rows.description: Analytics rows; columns depend on groupBy.

analytics.styleActions.title: Get Library Analytics Style Action Data
analytics.styleActions.description: Weekly time-series counts of style insertions and detachments for a published library file, grouped by style or team. Enterprise-plan organizations only; requires the library_analytics:read scope.

fileKey.description: File key of the published library to read analytics for.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); data starts from the week containing it. Defaults to one year ago.

endDate.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); data ends at the week containing it. Defaults to the latest full week.

rows.description: Analytics rows; columns depend on groupBy.

analytics.styleUsages.title: Get Library Analytics Style Usage Data
analytics.styleUsages.description: Summary of how many instances of each style in a published library exist across files, grouped by style or by file. Enterprise-plan organizations only; requires the library_analytics:read scope.

fileKey.description: File key of the published library to read analytics for.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

rows.description: Analytics rows; columns depend on groupBy.

analytics.variableActions.title: Get Library Analytics Variable Action Data
analytics.variableActions.description: Weekly time-series counts of variable insertions and detachments for a published library file, grouped by variable or team. Enterprise-plan organizations only; requires the library_analytics:read scope.

fileKey.description: File key of the published library to read analytics for.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); data starts from the week containing it. Defaults to one year ago.

endDate.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); data ends at the week containing it. Defaults to the latest full week.

rows.description: Analytics rows; columns depend on groupBy.

analytics.variableUsages.title: Get Library Analytics Variable Usage Data
analytics.variableUsages.description: Summary of how many instances of each variable in a published library exist across files, grouped by variable or by file. Enterprise-plan organizations only; requires the library_analytics:read scope.

fileKey.description: File key of the published library to read analytics for.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

rows.description: Analytics rows; columns depend on groupBy.

payments.get.title: Get Payments
payments.get.description: Fetch a user's payment information for a plugin, widget, or Community file owned by the token's account. Provide userId and exactly one of communityFileId, pluginId, or widgetId. The Payments API does not support OAuth2 — it authenticates with the personal access token only, and the user id comes from having that user OAuth2 to the Figma REST API.

userId.description: Id of the user whose payment information to fetch, as a string because Figma ids exceed 53-bit precision.

communityFileId.description: Community file id (the number after 'file/' on its Community page).

pluginId.description: Plugin id from its manifest or Community page (the number after 'plugin/').

widgetId.description: Widget id from its manifest or Community page (the number after 'widget/').

outputSchema.description: PaymentInformation for the user on the resource.

team.listComponentSets.title: List Team Component Sets
team.listComponentSets.description: List published component sets in a Figma team's library. Paginate with pageSize and after/before cursor integers from a previous response. Requires the team_library_content:read scope.

pageSize.description: Results per page. Figma defaults to 30.

after.description: Return component sets after this cursor.

before.description: Return component sets before this cursor.

inputSchema.description: Team whose component sets to list.

after.description: Cursor to fetch the next page.

before.description: Cursor to fetch the previous page.

devResources.update.title: Update Dev Resources
devResources.update.description: Bulk update the name and/or URL of existing dev resources, each identified by its id. Successes are listed in linksUpdated; per-resource failures come back in errors while the call still returns 200. Requires the file_dev_resources:write scope.

id.description: Unique identifier of the dev resource.

name.description: New name of the dev resource.

url.description: New URL of the dev resource.

devResources.description: List of dev resource updates. Each entry needs an id and at least a new name or url.

linksUpdated.description: Ids of dev resources that were updated.

items.description: Error entry with id and error.
